data.spec: Implemented in isolated NLS/facility-operations from main0740237 (local only, tests underway). Add metric surface_temperature_c input; temperature_drop_c/condensation_margin_c backend-derived only (client ingestion rejected). GET /api/facility/operations -> {policy,climate:[board_id,simulation,evaluated_at,temperature_c,humidity_pct,surface_temperature_c,dewpoint_c,dewpoint_state,condensation_margin_c,condensation_state,temperature_drop_c,rapid_cooling_state,cooling_coverage_seconds,reasons],readiness:[id,scheduled_at,evaluated_at,work_id,status,simulation:false,checks],refill_checks:[id,order_id,incident_id,board_id,item_id,simulation(sensor source),receipt_simulation,receipt_at,due_at,reset_value,baseline_value,status,work_id,verified_at,reading_event_id],incident_work:[incident_id,work_id,status],repeat_faults,evaluated_at}. Types/schema in packages/contracts/src/facility-operations.ts; metrics single source facility-metrics.ts. WorkCreate/WorkItem optional followup:{interval_minutes:1..10080,max_reminders:0..10}; existing defaults unchanged. Condition/refill Work context facility_managed protects sensor-verification steps from manual evidence/closure/cancel; sensor recovery completes only condition Work, never maintenance repair. Config readiness auto-registers weekday07:30Europe/Oslo routine; missed same-day slots skip on initial setup aftertime, recurrenceuses existingDSTscheduler. Supplier confirmations never verifyrefill; only authoritative explicit receipt starts matchingitem/station/source freshstock verification. Ownerroot; no runtime/serial/hardware changes.
